text:
Sam - AE: Heads up - large enterprise POC asking for a 3-month trial with a 40% introductory discount plus a 12mo commit if POC successful. They want billing start delayed until GA. Any objections to routing as a temporary promo + commit exception?
Rachel - RevOps: @Sam please include expected ARR if commit converts and the customer entity name. Routing: deal desk approval -> RevOps pricing ticket -> finance sign-off for deferred billing.
Sam - AE: Company: Nimbus Analytics. ARR estimate: $250k if they hit commit. POC value: $18k/month for 3 months.
Alex - Sales Eng: Quick note: for POC please ensure model/throughput SLOs are scoped in the SOW so we can size Dedicated vs hosted usage.
Jess - Legal: Deferred billing + promo needs a short addendum in the SOW. Also need to confirm data residency and confidentiality clauses for the POC. I can draft a two-paragraph addendum.
Naveen - Finance: Deferred billing ok for POC but we need a signed commitment (12mo) and a start date, or pre-agreed milestone that triggers billing. For accounting, we can't recognize deferred revenue until billing starts. Also need to know if discount applies to whole commit or just first 12 months.
Sam - AE: They want discount only for the first 12 months of the commit. After that it reverts to list.
Rachel - RevOps: Ok — process: 1) Create RevOps ticket with SKU, discount %, effective dates, linked quote ID. 2) Attach SOW + Legal addendum. 3) Paste the exact commit clause and billing trigger. 4) Deal desk reviews and routes to Finance for final approval.
Alex - Sales Eng: POC sizing snippet to include in SOW:
```
POC scope: up to 30 concurrent sessions, 2M tokens/day, latency target 200ms p50. If usage exceeds this, parties will evaluate Dedicated sizing and costs.
```
Sam - AE: @Jess can you draft the addendum today? We need to get the RevOps ticket filed before EOD to meet their internal quarter booking timeline.
Jess - Legal: I can get a draft by 3pm PT. Will include a clause: "introductory discount applies to first 12 months of paid service upon billing start; billing start defined as the date customer accepts go-live checklist or 30 days after SOW execution, whichever comes first." Thoughts?
Naveen - Finance: That wording works. Finance also needs explicit language that credits are non-refundable and any usage overage is billed at list.
Rachel - RevOps: Once @Jess posts the draft, @Sam file the RevOps ticket with the quote attachment and tag @dealdesk in the ticket. Use ticket template "pricing-exception-v2".
dealbot: RevOps ticket created: D-4321 by Sam - AE (status: draft)
Sam - AE: Filed D-4321 and attached Jess's draft when ready. @Rachel tagging for deal desk review.
Rachel - RevOps: Putting this on today's deal desk agenda. If approved, we'll issue a special pricing approval doc with a unique promo code and expiry. Expect answer by 5pm PT. :thumbsup:
Alex - Sales Eng: One more: make sure to include the model variant allowed under the promo (e.g., small-latency optimized only) so we avoid accidental cost overruns.
Jess - Legal: Added that restriction in paragraph 3. Will post final addendum to the ticket in 20m.
Naveen - Finance: If deal desk approves, Finance signs off on deferred billing terms and we update the quote. Please note: revenue recognition rules may delay ARR booking to the quarter when billing starts.
Sam - AE: Thanks all. Will stand by for deal desk outcome.
Rachel - RevOps: Approved by deal desk at 16:50 PT. Conditions: discount capped at first 12 months, promo code expires 90 days from approval, SOW addendum signed, commit milestone defined as "Production go-live" in SOW. Tagging @Naveen for final finance sign-off.
Naveen - Finance: Finance signs off on conditions. Please ensure quote reflects deferred billing start and revenue team is notified.
Sam - AE: Great — moving forward. Sending final quote and SOW to Nimbus now. :rocket:
